source_identity.canonical_title: Accuser le féminisme d'ignorer la souffrance des hommes est tout aussi absurde qu'accuser les organismes de lutte contre la pauvreté d'ignorer la souffrance des riches

translation.canonical_title: Accusing feminism of ignoring men's suffering is every bit as absurd as accusing organizations fighting poverty of ignoring the suffering of the rich
translation.displayed_title: Accusing feminism of ignoring men's suffering is every bit as absurd as accusing organizations fighting poverty of ignoring the suffering of the rich
translation.summary: It is logical for a movement intended for a particular group to focus exclusively on that group, since that is its reason for existing. Reproaching feminists for ignoring men’s suffering therefore makes no more sense than reproaching organizations fighting poverty for ignoring the suffering of the rich, queer groups for ignoring the suffering of cisgender heterosexual people, antiracist groups for ignoring the suffering of white people, and so on.
